+//
+// Configuration options:
+//   - AEGIS_PROXY_CLIENT_CERT_SAN_SUFFIX: Comma-separated list of allowed SAN suffixes for client certificates. If set, only clients with at least one SAN ending with an allowed suffix may connect. Example: ".trusted.example.com,.corp.local"

comments: Client-cert SAN suffix policy is implemented via the AEGIS_PROXY_CLIENT_CERT_SAN_SUFFIX env var, with config surface, parsing, and enforcement in server.go.
Enforcement occurs at the start of ServeHTTP, denying requests with a warning/audit log if the client cert SAN does not match the allowed suffixes.
Client-cert subject and serial are logged on session.start via auditSessionStart, which includes subject, serial, SANs, CN, and AKID if present.
TLS 1.2+, mTLS, and cipher suite restrictions are preserved: tls.Config.MinVersion is TLS1.2, ClientAuth is RequireAndVerifyClientCert, and strong cipher suites are enforced.
Deployment wires the new env var (AEGIS_PROXY_CLIENT_CERT_SAN_SUFFIX) with documentation and a default empty value.
